resources.string: A SIM that isn\'t in this phone
Used for people in this label who don\'t have a SIM of their own.
Keep in touch when they join your Circle
When you add someone from “%1$s” to your Circle, Parley suggests this rhythm first.
Works by starring everyone here, which also puts them in Favourites: Android lets starred contacts ring
Let “%1$s” ring during Do Not Disturb?
Everyone in this label is already starred, so they are already in Favourites.
Then, in Android\'s Do Not Disturb settings, allow calls from starred contacts. Everyone starred can ring, not only this label. Turning this off unstars only the people Parley starred for it.
